# agentic-news

Turn niche news into short, sourced, verified articles with a TL;DR first.

Keywords: news,rss,atom,summarization,fact-check,content-pipeline,agentic-suite,cli,mcp.

- SDK: import { runNews, parseConfig, verifySummary } from "agentic-news".
- CLI: agentic-news run --config site.json (a dry run unless --live).
- MCP: run agentic-news mcp, then call validate_config, verify_summary, run_news or list_pending.
